label: Love and devotion
definition: The singer loves someone and says so: tenderness, commitment, happiness of being together.
include: Declarations, promises, gratitude to a lover; love going well.
exclude: Love lost or refused (heartbreak); purely physical attraction (desire); love for everyone (spirituality).

label: Heartbreak and jealousy
definition: Love that hurts: rejection, break-up, betrayal, jealousy, a lover who leaves or does not care.
include: Pleading to keep someone, bitterness after a break-up, threats out of jealousy.
exclude: Loneliness without a lost lover (loneliness); regret for times past in general (nostalgia).

label: Desire and courtship
definition: Wanting someone: attraction, seduction, asking for a dance, a kiss or a night.
include: Chasing someone, asking them out, physical attraction.

label: Loneliness and isolation
definition: Being alone, unseen or cut off from others, by circumstance or by choice.
include: Portraits of lonely people, the singer feeling apart from the world.

label: Memory and nostalgia
definition: Looking back: places, people and times remembered, the passing of time.
include: Childhood places, remembering friends and lovers of the past, ageing.
exclude: A break-up told in the past tense without longing for the past (heartbreak).

label: Spirituality and transcendence
definition: Beyond the self: meditation, God, consciousness, universal love, acceptance, the illusion of the material world.
include: Eastern philosophy, calls to let go, love as a universal principle.
exclude: Drug imagery without a spiritual claim (dream and fantasy).

label: Society and politics
definition: Comment on the world: politics, money, power, war, revolution, social roles.
include: Taxes, revolution, class, fame, the establishment, peace as a political call.
exclude: A single character's story without a general point (characters and stories).

label: Identity and the self
definition: The singer looks at themself: who they are, how they change, independence, doubt, need for help.
include: Introspection, crisis, asserting oneself, growing up.
exclude: Introspection that is only about a lover (love themes).

label: Friendship and togetherness
definition: Friends, family, community: help, solidarity, belonging, the group.
include: Support between friends, family members, singing together, the band itself.
exclude: A lover addressed as a friend (love themes).

label: Characters and stories
definition: The song tells about other people: a portrait, an anecdote, a story with characters.
include: Third-person narratives, named characters, scenes of everyday life.
exclude: A 'you' who is the singer's lover (love themes).

label: Dream, fantasy and the surreal
definition: Imaginary worlds, dreamlike or absurd images, wordplay for its own sake, psychedelic visions.
include: Fantasy places, nonsense, altered perception, children's-story worlds.

label: Music, dance and fun
definition: The song is about music, dancing, partying, playing or having a good time.
include: Calls to dance, songs about songs and bands, celebrations.
exclude: Courtship on the dance floor (desire), if the person matters more than the dance.

label: Nature and the seasons
definition: The natural world as a subject: landscapes, animals, weather, the sun and the seasons, the countryside.
include: Songs set in or about nature, the turn of the seasons, animals as themselves.
exclude: Nature as a passing image for a lover (love themes) or as a way to the divine (spirituality); imaginary landscapes (dream).

label: Food and drink
definition: Eating and drinking as a subject: meals, sweets, tea, alcohol, their pleasures and their excesses.
include: Songs about what one eats or drinks, or built on it.
exclude: A drink or a meal in passing within a scene (characters).
